subject: Agent402 Smart Order Router competitive boundary

observed_claims.router_behavior: Free task resolution followed by paid execution; ranks by match score, rolling crawl health, then price, and can pay an external seller on the buyer's behalf.
observed_claims.health_method: Hourly unpaid probes of manifests and live 402 challenges; rolling health used to route around unavailable sellers.
observed_claims.host_exclusion: Agent402 states its own canary and volume runs are excluded from ranked external settlement figures.

decision.remaining_testable_wedge: Exact locked-task post-purchase outcome economics: deterministic acceptance, repeated retry/failure and settlement history, response latency and settled spend converted to retry-adjusted effective cost per acceptable result, with evidence that this changes provider selection beyond Agent402-style match+health+price routing.
decision.benchmark_baseline_addition: Add Agent402 Smart Order Router as an explicit baseline comparator. James only clears differentiation if exact-task outcome economics materially changes provider choice versus match+health+price routing, not merely versus cheapest quote.

evidence_class: external competitor observation; not paid benchmark evidence
restrictions: Do not infer acceptance quality from settlement counts.
Do not treat advertised tool count as observed successful execution.
Do not populate James paid benchmark fields from this artifact.
